title: Everyone Who Has Held This Ground
openingText: Oule has three ages of rubble under his boots and a banner that has been struck through on every stone in sight. He does not sit and does not offer. 'Every party that has held this crossing lost it,' he says. 'I am aware of the pattern. I am going to be the exception, and you are going to help me or you are going to be part of the stratum. Speak.'
openingTextLate: Oule's banner carries new stitching over old burns, and his pickets stand where the rubble is freshest. 'The pattern is accelerating,' he says. 'Every claimant loses this crossing faster than the last. I remain determined to be the exception. Speak.'
dialogueWalkaway: Then you are hostile by default and my pickets have your description.
dialogueAccept: Done. Hold to it. I have never yet had to explain what happens otherwise twice.
confidence: The pickets are all of it. Oule commands one under-strength company and a banner.

clauses.text: Passage to the junction itself, where the ley-lines cross and nobody is permitted.
Three ages of dropped material, and Oule's map of which layer is which.
You are entered as his auxiliary. Every other claimant here learns it within the day.
Thirty supplies to a force that has been holding open ground for a season.
Their dispositions: where every picket and camp on this ground stands
Safe conduct under their banner: no patrol will trouble you
Provisions from your stores for their line
Your party stands a watch on their line
